m0.meta_description: Coco M0 keeps project context and prior decisions locally on your own machine across AI coding tools. Private beta; not open source or publicly licensed.
kns: Kept locally on your own machine
m0.does_for_you: Coco M0 keeps project context and earlier decisions on your own computer, so the AI coding tools you use on that machine do not start from scratch each session.
m0.who_detail: You move between more than one AI coding tool on the same machine and keep re-explaining what you already decided. You want that memory kept locally, under your control.
does: Keeps context on your machine
Project notes and prior decisions stay on your own computer, with no cloud sync.
Carries work across tools
Switch between coding tools on the same machine without re-explaining earlier decisions.
Stays under your control
The memory sits under your own user account, and you choose which tools take part.

hermes.meta_description: Coco Hermes answers questions over your own local files with exact verbatim quotes, or says plainly it cannot. Private beta, not publicly licensed.
kns: Sentences tied to your source files
Says plainly when files lack the answer
Runs locally on your own machine
hermes.does_for_you: Coco Hermes indexes documents on your own computer and answers a question with the exact sentence from your files and a link to its source. If your files do not answer it, it says so instead of guessing.
hermes.who_detail: You work from your own documents, such as notes, contracts or research, and a plausible-sounding wrong answer would cost you more than no answer.
does: Point it at local folders
Choose documents on your machine without uploading files off the computer.
Ask a direct question
Candidate passages are searched locally, with no external network calls.
Quote verbatim or refuse
Every answer cites the exact sentence in your file, or states plainly that the documents do not answer it.

teams-ng.meta_description: Coco Teams NG is a local-first console for hiring, briefing, and reviewing a team of specialist AI members. Private beta, in development in the lab.
kns: Direct multi-role work in one console
teams-ng.does_for_you: Coco Teams NG is a console for organising AI specialists by role. You hire the members you need, brief them on project work in one place, and review what they produce before it lands.
teams-ng.who_detail: You want more than one undifferentiated chat thread: distinct roles with clear scopes, briefs you can inspect, and a calm place to review the results.
does: Hire distinct roles
Assemble AI specialists with explicit scopes rather than one undifferentiated chat thread.
Brief in one console
Hand structured tasks to the right member and keep every brief inspectable.
Review work before it lands
Check outputs and open decisions from one calm view on your machine.

aloomannu.name: Aloo Mannu
aloomannu.description: The local message and wake layer for coding agents on your machine.
aloomannu.meta_description: Aloo Mannu is the local message and wake layer for coding agents on your own machine, routing asks and replies through plain files and hooks.

cats_stage.story: Named after two cats at home: one calls out ("ow ow"), and the other answers ("meh") and comes over.

kns: Files and hooks on one machine
Zero cloud relays or remote servers
aloomannu.does_for_you: Aloo Mannu routes asks, replies and updates between coding agent sessions on your own machine through local files and tool hooks, wakes the session that needs to answer, and keeps one clear record of open asks.
aloomannu.who_detail: You run more than one coding agent session on the same machine and want them to pass work to each other without a cloud service, with nothing left unanswered.
does: Send an addressed ask or update
Write a structured message from one coding agent session to another on your computer.
Deliver through local hooks
Tool hooks surface pending messages in the receiving session without cloud polling.
Close every open ask
Open asks stay visible locally until a matching reply closes them.
status: Private beta, in daily lab use
Private: not open source and not publicly licensed.
Local files and hooks on one machine, Python standard library
No network, no cloud relays, no models; deterministic message routing
